notes: The telemetry_history table does not have a dedicated pattern_type column
Pattern data is stored in the metadata JSONB column or in-memory telemetry
VTS writes pattern data to in-memory telemetry with signalType and strategy fields
Canonical mapping provides patternType via getPatternForStrategy(strategy)
No database migration needed - pattern inference uses canonical source at runtime
recommendation: Pattern type is derived at runtime from canonical strategy mapping. No schema changes required.
